LESSON: READING 14.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: SUMMARISING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to summarise information?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main ideas in texts
2. write a summary of ideas from varied texts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main ideas in texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main ideas in texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. write a summary of ideas from varied texts
   In simple words: practise until you can write a summary of ideas from varied texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising.
4. Show that you can: identify the main ideas in texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a print or non-print text on varied issues, including outdoor games, and underline the main ideas,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to summarise information?
2. What factors should one consider when summarising an event?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main ideas in texts
2. write a summary of ideas from varied texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
